score_objections.objection: The only evidence is a single yes vote on the March 2024 TikTok divestiture bill, which passed 352-65 and was framed as a national-security/foreign-adversary measure, not as a Big Tech regulation position. One near-unanimous vote is too thin to place him on the tech_regulation scale.

Both sources show general CCP hawkishness (CECC appointment, DHS working-group bill) and the tracker's own claim concedes there is no chip-specific position. Neither source touches semiconductors or export controls, so 'Leans hawkish' on chips is an inference with no direct evidence.

score_objections.objection: None of the sources contain a position on semiconductor export controls or selling chips abroad.
